author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A small turrid recorded at Punta Mona, Manzanillo and Punta Cahuita in 1998 to 2000 survey samples. It lives under rocks and rubble and is rarely noticed by divers.
note.es: Un turrido pequeño registrado en Punta Mona, Manzanillo y Punta Cahuita en muestreos de 1998 a 2000. Vive bajo rocas y escombro y los buzos rara vez lo notan.

evidence: GBIF: 3 survey records (1998 to 2000), 2 to 8 m
